# Audibene & GrowthBook | Erstgespräch
Date: 2026-10-07 | Duration: 47m

## Summary
The discussion covered self-hosted and cloud pricing, with self-hosting costing around $6,000 per user and cloud hosting about $1,000 yearly per user. Hosting options include self-hosted, cloud, and EU cloud; self-hosting supports internal control, while cloud hosting provides stronger enterprise features and customer success support. The product centers on experiment-based testing, including complex and niche tests, contextual bandits, feature toggling, and advanced targeting across retail, e-commerce, education, and fashion. Analytics integrates with a data warehouse through read-only access to provide a single source of truth for growth metrics. Paid marketing uses Facebook, TikTok, and Instagram in Thailand, with funnel optimization and lead determination through in-app journeys. Features include SSO, training, implementation, unlimited seats on feature-flexible plans, and enterprise-grade security.

## Keywords
experiment-based analytics, cloud hosting, self-hosting, AI assistant, growthbook pricing, customer journey analytics
